title: AL methods limited during write transactions (RunModal, Codeunit.Run)
summary: New performance guidance documents platform restrictions on calling RunModal and Codeunit.Run methods during write transactions, explaining when each method is blocked and how to structure code to avoid triggering the runtime error.
key_points: Page.RunModal is never allowed in a write transaction; Report and XmlPort.RunModal only when the request page is suppressed
Codeunit.Run is allowed only when its return value is unused
'Modal page' removed from the user-prompts article because that case fails with a runtime error rather than stalling
Recommended structure follows Base Application's Commit() before Page.RunModal pattern
Performance review skill gains RunModal and UseRequestPage cues and routes Codeunit.Run to its existing article
